clinician.trajectory_summary: A 60-year-old man presented with lower abdominal pain, maroon-colored bowel movements, and hematemesis. Abdominal and pelvic CT with contrast revealed ileo-ileal intussusception with a suspicious small bowel mass. Surgical resection of the lesion confirmed a 1.2-cm well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor with one positive lymph node and Ki-67 <1%, consistent with grade 1 and T3N1 staging. Postoperative course included a transient ileus which resolved conservatively.
